sections.title: Welding Training & Certification
body: Modern vehicles rely on advanced materials and precise welding for structural integrity and safety. As a certified welding technician, you ensure every weld meets OEM specifications after collision repairs.

image.alt: Welder in a bodyshop practicing proper welding techniques after achieving his I-CAR Welding Certification

sections.title: Responsibilities
body: Welding technicians support safe, compliant repairs throughout the collision repair process.

cards.title: Core Responsibilities
listItems: Applying specialized welding knowledge that supports every role in the collision repair facility
Performing welds that meet OEM-approved procedures and safety standards
Understanding how welding integrates with structural, non-structural, and refinishing processes
Staying current with evolving welding technologies and repair requirements

sections.title: Path to Certification
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-4 pt-2 pt-md-0 mt-md-3

cards.title: Getting Certified
cards.body: Build the core skills needed before your certification event.

cards.title: Recertification Process
cards.body: Recertification focuses on performance testing and hands-on readiness.

cards.title: Getting Certified
listItems: Complete online and hands-on course prerequisites
Learn how to adjust and tune welders

cards.title: Recertification Process
listItems: Requires welders to perform the welds without assistance
Students should already be familiar with how to adjust and tune welding machines

sections.title: Welding Event Preparation
body: Get ready for your in-shop welding event and take the steps to get certified.

image.alt: Students in a bodyshop learning proper welding techniques during an I-CAR welding course to get welding certified
